==Biography==
On October 11, 2013, it was announced by Garena Taiwan that Lilballz was found guilty of using someone else's account to play ranked queue. The following ruling was announced: Account suspension and Ineligible for competing in Garena-hosted tournaments for one year.<ref>[http://lol.esport.garena.tw/news/news_info.php?nid=1735 【LNL 台港澳聯賽】AZB TPA Lilballz 選手違反停權管理規章 懲處公告 (Taiwanese)] ''lol.esport.garena.tw''</ref>

On his Facbook account, Lilballz explained that he just borrowed the account of a friend due to the long ranked queues. He announced his retirement of playing competitively, but will still be assisting in training TPA/TPS along with their current coach Fluidwind.

== Trivia ==
* Favorite champion is {{ci|Alistar}}.
* Studied in Canada.
* Was friends in high school with [[Bigfatjiji]]. They met in a LAN center after they both skipped school on the same day to play video games.
* The name Lilballz is derived from the opposite meaning of Bigfatjiji.
* Coined the term "NFGL" while playing with Bigfatjiji. <ref>[http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fW7jSrlaidg NFGL! (video)] ''youtube.com''</ref>
* Being described as one of the trollest player at Taiwan server since retiring from competitive gaming.<ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5Ud1dDXGrms#t=2m56s 【Lilballz】實況精華 - 魔競啊魔競，誰是世界上最欠吉的人？ (By 光信) 2016/12/24] ''youtube.com''</ref>
